description: Defines the NetworkDelegate interface for handling network request events and policies in Chromium's net module.

classes.name: NetworkDelegate
classes.description: An interface for handling network request lifecycle events and policies, including request modification, cookie handling, privacy modes, and reporting policies.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is sent, allowing URL rewriting.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeStartTransaction
methods.description: Called before the network transaction starts, allowing header modification.

methods.name: NotifyHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when HTTP response headers are received, allowing inspection or modification.

methods.name: NotifyResponseStarted
methods.description: Called when a response has started.

methods.name: NotifyCompleted
methods.description: Called when a request completes or fails.

methods.name: NotifyURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Called when a URL request is destroyed.

methods.name: AnnotateAndMoveUserBlockedCookies
methods.description: Allows blocking of cookies based on policies.

methods.name: CanSetCookie
methods.description: Determines if a cookie can be set for a request.

methods.name: ForcePrivacyMode
methods.description: Determines privacy mode for a request.

methods.name: CancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Cancels requests with policy-violating referrer headers.

methods.name: CanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if a reporting report can be queued for an origin.

methods.name: CanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Determines if reporting reports can be sent.

methods.name: CanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be set for an origin.

methods.name: CanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be used for an origin.

methods.name: GetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cache filter match info for first-party sets, possibly asynchronously.
